certification_on_chain.description: Cache of CertificationNFT data minted on the OGCR chain (chain id 2025). One record per certification_of_compliance_id, populated by OGCR-chain-cache reading the chain.

certification_of_compliance_id.description: Links to the `certificate_of_compliance` dynamic entity. The on-chain CertificationNFT is keyed by this id.

token_id.description: CertificationNFT token id minted for this certificate.

activity_nft_id.description: ActivityNFT token id this certification references (stored on-chain).

issue_date.description: Certification issue date as stored on-chain.

expiry_date.description: Certification expiry date as stored on-chain.

activity_url.description: activity_url stored on-chain for the linked activity.

activity_hash.description: activity_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the linked activity entity body.

certification_url.description: certification_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certificate_of_compliance entity.

certification_hash.description: certification_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certificate entity body.

owner_address.description: Current owner of the NFT (operator OGCR wallet address).

token_uri.description: tokenURI of the NFT (ERC721 metadata data-URI).

contract_address.description: CertificationNFT contract address the token was read from.

tx_hash.description: Mint transaction hash (from the CertificationMinted event).

block_number.description: Block number the mint was included in.
